Settings.AutoOpenWindow: Open the dossier window automatically when a battle ends
Settings.AutoOpenWindow.Tooltip: The battle-end letter is sent either way.
Settings.EndCapTicks.Tooltip: Battles normally conclude shortly after the last active threat is gone. This is only a fallback: if combat falls silent for this long while a threat lingers (e.g. an unreachable enemy turret), the session ends anyway.
Settings.MinBattleScale.Tooltip: A new fight only opens its own dossier once the hostile force on the map reaches this combined combat power. Smaller skirmishes (a lone manhunter, a stray maddened animal) are ignored — unless they happen during a battle that is already being recorded.
Settings.MaxStoredDossiers.Tooltip: When set, the oldest unpinned dossiers are deleted as new battles finish. 0 means unlimited. Pinned dossiers are always kept.
